g.title: KayaRank5Convo2 begins.
g.text: KayaRank5Convo2 begins.

g.title: j4058689187
g.text: How about I ask *you* about time travel this time?

g.title: j3319553890
g.text: Nah. Let's talk about something else actually! Ok?

g.title: j3602582192
g.text: Check boolean KayaPromiseRegret

g.title: j2494002427
g.text: Like my biggest regret?

g.title: j3602582192->j2494002427
g.text: true

g.title: j2182574893
g.text: Like what? You choose.

g.title: j3602582192->j2182574893
g.text: false

g.title: j2253245063
g.text: How about... Kalymos?

g.title: j3602582192->j2253245063
g.text: false

g.title: j450178717
g.text: Hmm okay yeah sure. What is it?

g.title: j1469403920
g.text: Ummm I guess... my first pet?

g.title: j480222024
g.text: Yeah Yeah she's fine, I'm more of a dog girl though. Grew up with one. I wish I could see him again.

g.title: j132156953
g.text: Not demanding more from Albrecht.

g.title: j315243728
g.text: Not stopping Ballas sooner.

g.title: j1823113799
g.text: Giving up on myself.

g.title: j2824729348
g.text: Although that's usually one of those hacker internet questions so uhh don't tell anyone.

g.title: j1193889289
g.text: My sympathies. It's best to end here [End.]

g.title: j2440010729
g.text: I'm sorry to hear, tell me about him.

g.title: j3160136779
g.text: I've lost a pet too. What was his name?

g.title: j2366778308
g.text: It's like even after all this I just let him get away.

g.title: j2473204238
g.text: I don't know how I could have changed things.

g.title: j4130301712
g.text: It doesn't matter what it looks like to anyone else. There was a point when no one hated me more than myself.

g.title: j2415885203
g.text: But his name was Zylo. You'd call him a Kubrow I think.

g.title: j3219460250
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j3558993220
g.text: It's kind of unfair actually. Entrati gets to time travel around with his freaky-feline?

g.title: j753471288
g.text: I know he thinks he's teaching me something, but that asshole doesn't even realize what he put me through.

g.title: j1261990551
g.text: But I know that if I was even a minute faster, someone would have suffered less.

g.title: j1138276795
g.text: I couldn't even DIE. And I wished I could.

g.title: j1936883386
g.text: HUGE, like biggest dog you could imagine. Could bite Mr. Volkov in half I bet.

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo3.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo3.

g.title: j3219460250->Chat ends. Next chat will be KayaRank5Convo3.
j537753824
g.text: If I had Zylo with me... this trip would be a lot easier.

g.title: j3348925758
g.text: And not JUST me. All of us. And Loid, Gomaitru... it's sickening. I don't know if I'll be able to hold back if I see him.

g.title: j1787737980
g.text: Ballas is everything I fear. He's the worst of life itself.

g.title: j1304800212
g.text: When you put it this way.. I guess life and people just kind of sucks sometimes doesn't it?

g.title: j1947374267
g.text: We've still got big Kubrows where I'm from!

g.title: j1226054422
g.text: Ehh I don't know, Mr. Volkov is pretty tough.

g.title: j1931042135
g.text: Zylo was the first living thing to see me cry, you know.

g.title: j3781919994
g.text: But then sometimes it's so awesome.

g.title: j1570362424
g.text: Oh my god... all the more reason for me to GET THERE. Wow!

g.title: j1573635266
g.text: Actually you might have a point... but anyway, big scary Zylo. But he was fiercely protective of me.

g.title: j1702171558
g.text: I was like 5 years old, and as long as I can remember I refused to cry.

g.title: j406560383
g.text: We can't define ourselves by our biggest regret I guess. I feel like you helped me move on from mine.

g.title: j4128053853
g.text: My Zylo was fiercely protective of me.

g.title: j2140770211
g.text: But I got home from my first day of first grade at school and Zylo was there.

g.title: j1746754537
g.text: But I wouldn't change that it happened.

g.title: j3158331533
g.text: And he followed me to my room and guarded the door while I just sobbed.

g.title: j2991145026
g.text: Because like, I don't hate this for me. Nova? Kind of the coolest thing ever.

g.title: j997383081
g.text: What made you so upset?

g.title: j1535253466
g.text: How do you remember that?

g.title: j1790711618
g.text: You wouldn't change a thing?

g.title: j527596234
g.text: Someone called me fat.

g.title: j2322651121
g.text: How could I forget?!

g.title: j1244294533
g.text: Not a damn thing. And I hope you wouldn't either.

g.title: j198886994
g.text: Which was like, the thing that made kids unpopular when I grew up.

g.title: j610456857
g.text: Kids can be so cruel.

g.title: j1017025924
g.text: Is being popular that important?

g.title: j2758404191
g.text: Everyone is cruel.

g.title: j1674883642
g.text: It was... until all this happened. I feel like I'm a better person after all this shit, like, I am who I truly should have been this whole time.

g.title: j3201435958
g.text: Everyone wants to be the cool kid.

g.title: j305180252
g.text: No more caring about what people think of me. Just.. getting to finally live.

g.title: j1130910111
g.text: But I've realized now, it's way cooler to not care about being cool. That's why you're so cool.

g.title: j4093832494
g.text: I feel like I'm a better person after all this shit, like, I am who I truly should have been this whole time.
